steps.name: real-source-no-credentials
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; [[ $(id -u) == 1000 ]]; [[ -z ${KILN_WORKLOAD_TOKEN+x} ]]; [[ ! -e /work/.git ]]; [[ -f /work/Cargo.toml ]]; [[ -f /work/crates/kiln-hosted/src/execution.rs ]]; [[ ! -e /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 ]]; [[ ! -e /root/.aws/credentials ]]; [[ ! -e /work/operator.key ]]; [[ ! -e /work/server.key ]]; [[ $(ls /sys/class/net) == lo ]]; printf 'KILN_APPROVED_UNTRUSTED_OK source=exact-native-git workload_token=absent network=none guest_uid=%s\n' "$(id -u)"
